# Miscellaneous Workflows

This folder contains deprecated, experimental, or one-time use workflows that are not part of the main CI/CD pipeline.

## Contents

- **aftermath.yml** - Deprecated workflow with empty triggers
- **flatten-repo-download.yml** - One-time repository flattening utility
- **zendesk-quantum-packaging.yml** - Experimental quantum packaging workflow
- **biweekly-research-digest.yml** - Low-priority research digest generator

## Status

These workflows are **inactive** and moved here during Phase 1 consolidation (2026-02-07).

## Restoration

If needed, these workflows can be restored to `.github/workflows/` directory.

## Cleanup

These workflows may be permanently deleted in a future cleanup phase.
